4. The HTML Template

4.1 Base Template

Each module template inherits from abpe_ui/base.html. The base.html automatically provides: Header, Sidebar, Footer, all Core CSS/JS, Bootstrap, Theme System, and Language System.

{% extends 'abpe_ui/base.html' %}
{% load static %}

{% block title %}My Module{% endblock %}

{% block module_css %}
<link href="{% static 'abpe_ui/css/mod/mod-my_module.css' %}" rel="stylesheet">
{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div class="container-fluid p-4">

    <!-- Page Title -->
    <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-4">
        <h2>
            <i class="bi bi-star"></i>
            <span data-i18n="my_module.title">My Module</span>
        </h2>
    </div>

    <!-- Content -->
    <div class="row g-3">
        <div class="col-md-6">
            <div class="card border-0 shadow-sm">
                <div class="card-header">
                    <i class="bi bi-info-circle"></i>
                    <span data-i18n="my_module.section_title">Section</span>
                </div>
                <div class="card-body">
                    <p data-i18n="my_module.description"></p>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

</div>
{% endblock %}

{% block module_js %}
<script src="{% static 'abpe_ui/js/mod/mod-my_module.js' %}"></script>
{% endblock %}

{% block extra_js %}
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    if (typeof loadLanguage === 'function') {
        loadLanguage('{{ current_lang|default:"de" }}', 'my_module');
    }
});
</script>
{% endblock %}

4.2 Template Blocks

BlockPurposeWhen to Use
titleBrowser Tab TitleAlways
module_cssInclude Module CSSIf CSS file exists
extra_cssAdditional Inline CSSRarely
contentMain Page ContentAlways
module_jsInclude Module JSIf JS file exists
extra_jsInline JS (Initialization)For loadLanguage() and init code

4.3 Context Variables

These variables are automatically available in every module template:

VariableTypeContent
current_langstringCurrent language: de, en, fr, it
active_modulestringID of the active module
active_subpagestring|NoneID of the active subpage
module_configdictComplete module.json as dictionary
main_navigationlistSidebar navigation
system_navigationlistSystem navigation (Admin, Logout)
userUserLogged-in Django User
user_is_adminboolTrue if is_staff
debugboolDjango DEBUG mode

4.4 ABPE_CONFIG (JavaScript)

The base.html provides a global JavaScript object available in every module JS:

window.ABPE_CONFIG = {
    is_admin:     true,        // User is Staff/Admin
    current_lang: 'de',        // Current language
    debug:        false,        // Django DEBUG
    api_url:      '/api/'       // API base URL
};

4.5 Bootstrap Classes in the Portal

The portal fully uses Bootstrap 5. Recommended structure for module content:

<!-- Page width with padding -->
<div class="container-fluid p-4">

    <!-- Card grid -->
    <div class="row g-3">
        <div class="col-md-6 col-lg-4">
            <div class="card border-0 shadow-sm">
                <div class="card-header">Title</div>
                <div class="card-body">Content</div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

</div>
